scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['index.html','styles.css','app.js','admin.html','admin.css','admin.js','server.mjs'])fs.copyFileSync(f,'dist/'+f);if(fs.existsSync('public'))fs.cpSync('public','dist/public',{recursive:true});console.log('Static site ready in dist/');})"
scripts.lint: node --check app.js && node --check admin.js && node --check server.mjs
